subheadline: Notes from the Desiderio team on theming, seeding and everyday editing.

posts.title: How one setting restyles all 244 elements
posts.excerpt: Colour tokens and semantic CSS variables let one site setting restyle every Desiderio element. A redesign can then be a settings change instead of a project.

image.title: Desiderio site settings theme category
image.alternative: The Desiderio theme settings in TYPO3, with options for preset, density and radius.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

posts.title: A backend preview for every element
posts.excerpt: All 244 Desiderio content elements show a real preview in the page module. Editors recognise each element at a glance and need less help to get started.

image.title: Desiderio page module previews
image.alternative: The TYPO3 page module showing Desiderio content elements with their previews.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

posts.title: A full demo site from one command
posts.excerpt: The command desiderio:styleguide:seed builds the whole styleguide. It is safe in workspaces and can run again without creating duplicates.
